mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening labor markets and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and INDPRO rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE falling > 0.2pp and INDPRO rising > 0.5% in 3 months fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate overbuilding and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) series indicates strengthening consumer demand and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rising HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 240, indicating elevated inflation, triggers monetary policy tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240, or the signal fails to outperform the market in 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in industrial production (INDPRO) and employment (PAYEMS) signals robust supply chain activity and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and PAYEMS rising > 0.5% in 3 months fails to produce positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime, a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic recovery and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% and UNRATE falls.
